title: Why Basie's small band left him out
summary: Edison felt lost and still doesn't know why Basie did not take him.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: When this break-up of the band came, did you say you wanted to go out?
I felt lost. I really felt lost.
Oh, I wondered if you thought it was time to --
No. I was confused. I really was.
Well, why didn't he take Clark?

I don't know. I don't know. That's what everybody wonders today, you know, why didn't he take myself? And -- like with Dicky Wells, the older guys out of the band. That's Basie's -- and Serge Chaloff and Buddy DeFranco. I couldn't see why he took any of them because Basie had enough soloists in his band to keep the thing going to me, you know.
Somebody must have sold him a bill of goods, you know. (Inaudible).
Yeah, I can imagine. I can imagine they did. But everybody wondered, why didn't Sweets go.
That's right. Well, I thought perhaps you, yourself, wanted to.
